caseName: General Gas & Electric Corp. v. Commissioner
caseNameFull: GENERAL GAS & ELECTRIC CORP. v. COMMISSIONER OF INTERNAL REVENUE
attorneys: Mr. Maurice Bower Saul, with whom Mr. Bradford S. Magill was on the brief, for petitioner., Miss Helen R. Carloss, with whom Solicitor General Jackson, Assistant Attorney General Morris, and Mr. Sewall Key were on the brief, for respondent.

opinions.author: Huberts
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Huberts

delivered the opinion of the Court.

These are companion cases to Nos. 486 and 487, ante, p. 522, and involve the same question. The Circuit Court pf Appeals held that conveyances by subsidiaries to the taxpayer, consummated under the Act pf April 29, 1874, did not constitute mergers so as to authorize the taxpayer to take a deduction for unamortized bond discount and expense in ''respect of bonds issued by the subsidiaries prior to the conveyance.

For reasons given in Nos. 486 and 487 the judgments must be

Reversed.
